meta.name: caveman-stats
meta.description: Show recorded output and cache-read token usage and mode attribution for the current Claude Code session, or locate the host's native usage report. Trigger: /caveman-stats.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查看当前会话的输出与缓存读取 token 用量及模式归属
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想弄清这次会话到底消耗了多少 token。
copy.tagline_en: Check token and cache-read usage and mode attribution for the current session
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to know how many tokens this session actually used

howto.what: 装上后,在 Claude Code 会话里运行 /caveman-stats,会显示本次会话记录的输出 token、缓存读取 token、回复次数,以及可得的模式归属。它只把报告原样打印在代码块里,不自己计算或重新四舍五入这些数字。
howto.when: 当你在 Claude Code 里输入 /caveman-stats,或加上 --all、--since 7d 等参数时触发;在 Gemini CLI 和其他环境里,它会引导你用所在环境自带的用量报告。

say.note: 打印本会话的 token 用量报告
按会话聚合最新记录的输出数
报告观察到的用量,节省仍为未知

howto.what_en: After installing, running /caveman-stats in a Claude Code session shows the recorded output tokens, cache-read tokens, response counts and mode attribution where available. It prints the report verbatim in a code block and does not recalculate or re-round the numbers.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you run /caveman-stats in Claude Code, or add flags like --all or --since 7d. In Gemini CLI and other hosts it points you to that host's native usage report instead.

say_en.note: Print this session's token usage report
Aggregate latest recorded output per session
